label: In the last ten trials, update gate dips after choosing a1, after a1-to-S2, and when believing S1.
terms: (tv("action", -1) == 1) * 0 + (ep_trial >= 90) * ((tv("action", -1) == 1) + (tv("action", -2) == 1) + (tv("action", -3) == 1)) ;; (phase == D2) * (in_action == 1) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_action == 1) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; belief_lo * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D2) * (in_action == 1) * (ep_trial >= 80) ;; (prev_action == 1) * (ep_trial >= 80) ;; (phase == D2) * (in_state == 2) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (ep_trial >= 90)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 8 sits near 1 almost always and sags late in the episode (timing baseline, strongest at D2). Beyond timing, the sag is concentrated in the final ~10 trials and depends on choice: at D2 after choosing a1 it drops much further (~-0.1), and after a previous a1 trial that reached S2 (rare) it drops at the following steps (strongest at D1); the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good lowers it further at late D2 (S1-favoring belief lowers z; S2 belief raises it). Before trial ~80 the effects are tiny (residual tables show a few thousandths). Rewards matter little. The free fit adds lateness at 80+, previous-a1 at D1/GO, state reached at D2 and unrewarded previous trial, giving modest gains. Only observed variables used; ceiling for profile-table additive cues is low (0.16) because the effect is an interaction with lateness.
